command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=$PATH:/opt/conda/bin TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/mpl
cd /tmp
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: staged bytes do not match their pins"; exit 1; }
# Sizing probe: 2,560 training images, one epoch, at 8 and 16 threads; then which oneDNN conv kernel runs.
( for T in 8 16; do LIMIT=2560 EPOCHS=1 THREADS=$T python3 -u cifar.py train p$T; done
  ONEDNN_VERBOSE=1 python3 -u -c 'import torch; c=torch.nn.Conv2d(16,16,3,1,1,bias=False); x=torch.randn(128,16,32,32,requires_grad=True); c(x).sum().backward()' ) > probe.log 2>&1
cat probe.log
grep -q 'TRAIN p16 OK' probe.log || { echo "FAIL: probe did not finish"; exit 1; }
echo DONE
